input.command: Get-ChildItem C:\Users\shrey\.ccproxy, C:\Users\shrey\Desktop\ccproxy | Select-Object FullName; Get-ChildItem C:\Users\shrey\.ccproxy -File | ForEach-Object { "== $($_.Name)"; Get-Content $_.FullName -TotalCount 40 }; Get-ChildItem C:\Users\shrey\Desktop\ccproxy -Recurse -Include *.yaml,*.yml,*.json,*.toml,*.env,README* -Depth 2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object FullName -notmatch 'node_modules|\.venv' | Select-String -Pattern 'port|host|url|localhost|http' | Select-Object -First 40
